text:
elaine: Hey team — opened PR to refresh the Quickstart auth flow and hello-world deploy example. mainly: swap outdated curl snippet, clarify REDWOOD_API_KEY vs session tokens, and add a tiny node example for SDK6. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1437 :wave:

sam: thanks! quick skim looked good. two small asks: make the curl example explicit about Content-Type and tighten the env var name (REDWOOD_API_KEY). also can we show a minimal example of using streaming responses?

mika: i can review the node snippet. fyi customers keep tripping over the `--data` vs `-d` wording in curl examples (tiny but confusing).

drew: opened a follow-up commit suggestion in the PR for the curl header fix. left a note about token rotation best-practices — should we link to the security guide?

elaine: @drew yes please link to /security/keys-and-rotation, i'll add that. for streaming i added an inline note and a short example but i want to keep the quickstart single-file minimal. maybe move extended streaming sample to a separate subsection.

sam: agreed. keep quickstart minimal and add a "next steps" section linking to streaming and retry patterns.

elaine: pushed update — replaced the curl snippet with this minimal example:

```
curl "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-lite","input":"Hello world"}'
```

elaine: and added a tiny NodeJS snippet for SDK6 users: `await client.responses.create({model: 'redwood-1-lite', input: 'Hello world'})`

mika: node snippet looks fine. can you add explicit import line at top? something like `import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'` so users copy-paste works.

elaine: good call — added import + small note about installing `@redwoodai/sdk@^6.0.0`.

ci-bot: github checks started for PR #1437 — lint, linkcheck, doctests.

sam: linkcheck might flake on the new inter-doc link — i changed it to an absolute path to be safe.

ci-bot: lint: passed. linkcheck: failed on 1 URL (internal anchor mismatch). doctests: running.

elaine: thanks CI — fixing anchor in security guide reference.

elaine: quick question for reviewers — do we want to call the env var REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere or mention legacy REDWOOD_TOKEN for older quickstarts? i left a short note about legacy tokens.

drew: mention legacy but mark as deprecated. we should avoid encouraging the older token in new quickstarts.

mika: +1 on deprecate callout. also add a one-liner troubleshooting tip about 401s: check API key scope and clock skew. customers keep hitting that.

elaine: added a Troubleshooting block: "401 Unauthorized — confirm REDWOOD_API_KEY set, ensure key has 'generation' scope, and verify system clock/timezone".

ci-bot: doctests: 2 failing (examples need real API key mocking).

sam: i can add a test helper that mocks the responses client so docs tests don't need a live key. will PR a small change to the docs test harness.

elaine: sweet — i'll hold this PR until that helper lands. leaving a note in PR description to rerun checks after #1440 merges.

doc-bot: summary: PR #1437 updates quickstart auth + hello-world examples, replaces curl snippet with explicit headers, adds SDK6 node example + install note, links to security key rotation guide, marks legacy token deprecated, and adds troubleshooting. blocked until test helper for doctests (#1440) lands.

sam: tagging reviewers @mika and @drew for final pass when tests green. :thumbsup:

mika: ack — can take a final read once CI is green. small nits only.

elaine: thanks all! i'll follow up after #1440 — should be quick. :rocket:
